openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Saturday, the day of Saturn. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Saturn rewards structure: build while everyone else sleeps in.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go own Saturday.

mindset.hed: The Weekend Is Where the Gap Opens
mindset.body: Kyle Monangai sat a month and came back the first day his body let him. Johnny Walker took a heavyweight main event on short notice, giving up 23 pounds. Nobody hands out the spot; you show up ready when it opens. Saturday is the day most people coast. Put in one real block before noon and you're a week ahead of them by Monday. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Saturday, the day of Saturn: run this right after Morning Charge. Near freezing outside (~31° at dawn), so keep the RipStick finisher indoors this morning. Strong, smooth reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: Apple opens its new Siri AI to every app
items.body: A developer preview lets apps hand their actions to Siri AI through App Intents, so you can ask in plain words to check a delivery or book a table inside an app. Customers get it in a few months; App Store submissions open in the spring.

items.hed: Grok text gets a hidden watermark starting today
items.body: From Nov 7, text from xAI's Grok models in the API carries an invisible watermark by default. It steers word choice slightly so the company can later recognize AI-written text; it says quality and speed are unchanged.

items.hed: METR: Anthropic moving about twice as fast
items.body: An independent review says AI tools are roughly doubling Anthropic's pace on coding and experiments. OpenAI meanwhile shipped GPT-6 Cyber for vetted security researchers. Much of the METR evidence was redacted.

items.hed: Lakers top Blazers 124-118, take first in the West
items.body: Luka Dončić tied Oscar Robertson with a seventh straight game of 35+ points, 5+ rebounds and 5+ assists.
Spurs beat the Kings 124-109 for seven straight. Wembanyama has 250+ points, 100+ rebounds and 35+ blocks through nine games, a mark only Kareem and Shaq had reached.
Jayson Tatum had 34, 8 and 9 as Boston hit 24 threes. Ajay Mitchell's career-high 35 led OKC past Memphis 128-97.

items.hed: Monangai questionable after first practice since Week 4
items.body: Ben Johnson said the toe injury has been 'fickle.' CBs Tyrique Stevenson and Malik Muhammad II are also questionable.

items.hed: Bears chase 7-2 in third straight prime-time game
items.body: Benedet, Jarrett and D'Marco Jackson shed their designations after full Friday practices. The bye comes after Sunday.
OLB Yaya Diaby (knee) is ruled out; Emeka Egbuka (foot) is questionable but practiced fully twice.

items.hed: Cortes Acosta has 23 pounds on Walker
items.body: Cortes Acosta weighed 262, Walker 239 for tonight's short-notice heavyweight main event at Meta APEX. Main card 7 PM CT on Paramount+.
Co-main Tatiana Suarez (115.5) vs Virna Jandiroba (116) could set up a strawweight title shot. Prelims start 4 PM CT.

Saturday belongs to Saturn, Kronos to the Greeks: time, limits, discipline and the long game. Old magicians used it for binding, endurance and laying foundations. Saturn is a hard teacher, but what you build under him lasts.
In Gnostic myth the Archons are rulers who keep souls asleep with distraction and routine. The cure was gnosis, direct knowing. Notice one thing today you do on autopilot and do it awake.

The 14th-century German mystic taught that God is found in letting go, not in grasping. 'The eye through which I see God is the same eye through which God sees me.' Do the work fully and drop the worry about the result.

grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'The soul of the sluggard desireth, and hath nothing: but the soul of the diligent shall be made fat' (Proverbs 13:4). Wanting is free; Saturn only pays out for the hours you actually put in.
